faq.q: Where are most South Surrey open houses?
faq.a: The page's own answer (site copy): Grandview Heights and White Rock first, then the King George Corridor and Morgan Creek. As market context, the largest attached listing pools in September 2026 were White Rock (193), Grandview (146) and King George Corridor (131) of 593 community-wide — as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR September 2026 report.

faq.q: What days and times do open houses usually run?
faq.a: The page's FAQ (site copy) says most occur on Saturdays and Sundays from 1–4 PM, with some weekday twilight showings. No official source publishes open-house scheduling statistics, so treat that as the page's general statement and confirm each home's own time with the listing brokerage.
